coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Potrero Power Station Block 1
record.summary: Planned mixed-use block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan with a stepped height envelope up to 180 ft, one of three blocks (with 5 and 13) eligible to host the project's single permitted district parking garage; no design review approval or construction start found.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- this block is not yet built and does not correspond to any subdivided Assessor parcel: it currently sits on vacant/graded land within the former power station site (unaddressed in DataSF's Assessor roll). Traced from an adopted regulatory diagram via multi-point real-street georeferencing (see digitization_method), but this diagram is dated 2020 and may not reflect later design changes (as already found for the UCSF/Sophie Maxwell area -- see digitization_method). Treat vertex positions as accurate to roughly 10-25m, not survey-grade, and treat the block's applicability itself as somewhat more provisional than Mission Rock's or Pier 70's equivalent entries. Rebuilt 2026-09-16 via GDAL GCP/TPS georeferencing -- see digitization_method. Re-measured 2026-09-16 (third pass) in a single consistent pixel-detection pass across the whole block layout -- see digitization_method. Re-corrected 2026-09-16 (fourth pass) after fixing a mis-measured GCP -- see digitization_method.
notes.digitized_from: Potrero Power Station Design for Development, Figure 6.2.3 - Building Height Plan (p.245).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor parcel may exist under this block (part of the site's larger, largely unaddressed footprint), but it has not been subdivided per the masterplan's individual named blocks -- this uses hand-traced approximate geometry instead.
notes.regulatory_context: Figure 6.2.3 shows Block 1 (marked '1*', a potential district parking garage/grocery store site) at 85 ft base / 180 ft max upper height -- NOT a 65-100 ft range as sometimes described secondhand. No source found supporting a 'potential SF Public Library branch' at this site -- that claim appears unsupported. No construction-start source found.

facts.value: Residential, Institutional, Retail, Non-Retail Sales/Services (office) and Entertainment/Arts/Recreation uses permitted; Laboratory and Life Science uses Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)

stepped envelope of 115 ft (max), 85 ft (base) and 180 ft (upper tower) across different portions of the block, per the D4D's Figure 6.2.3; the D4D's height-category text separately places Block 1 in a 'Midrise towers' category of 146-180 ft
Up to one District Parking Garage (max 90 ft, with a publicly accessible rooftop sports field) is permitted for the whole project, and may be sited only on Block 1, 5, or 13 -- not one per block
Not listed among the six Phase 1 blocks (2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) named in the 2024 annual compliance report

Read 2026-09-18.
images.appeal_note: Color-coded building height plan across the full 15-block site with a clear legend, but the small block-by-block labels don't resolve at card size.

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 1; it is not one of the six buildings named in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list (Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), and no later-phase design review approval was found either.

No source found claiming a specific planned use (e.g., grocery store) beyond the D4D's own generic 'Potential District Parking Garage Location, Potential Grocery Store Location' asterisk notation, which applies to Blocks 1, 5 and 13 collectively, not to Block 1 alone.
